_template: The Desk seat. Copy to seat/willow/.mcp.json and replace @HOME@ and @VAULT_BOX@. That file is NOT tracked — **/.mcp.json is globally ignored on an operator box because it carries absolute paths and a seat identity, the same rule deploy/kart-sandbox.template.json follows: the template travels, the wiring does not.
_why_here: Opening Claude Code with this directory as the working directory makes it the project root, so this config is what loads and session_enter seats you as willow. The repo root is Heimdallr's Watch. WILLOW_PROJECT_ROOT points at the grove root so the Desk reasons over the whole repository while the seat is chosen by where you opened it.
